title: Digitale Rätoromanische Chrestomathie (Biblioteca Digitala)
notes: DFG project (2009–2011) at the Universität zu Köln that digitized and deep-indexed Caspar Decurtins' 'Rätoromanische Chrestomathie' (~7,500 pages of Romansh texts), published as the 'Biblioteca Digitala' full-text corpus; data preservation is now with the Data Center for the Humanities (dch.phil-fak.uni-koeln.de, 200). The harvest covers Decurtins vol. V (Engadine 16th-c. authors Travers, Bifrun, Chiampell, Planta, Papa), matching origin 'DRC Vol V (Engadine 16th c.): Gian Travers'. Caveat: the crestomazia server deliberately answers HTTP 418 (anti-crawler 'teapot') to non-browser clients including this checker, so verify interactively in a browser; it is up, not dead (no 404/000). Text units are OCR'd chapters, not TEI. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Universitaet zu Koeln (Sprachliche Informationsverarbeitung / Universitaets- und Stadtbibliothek / Data Center for the Humanities)
